prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web storefront direction comp for SKYMART
Primary request: Design the actual edge-to-edge first viewport and beginning of the next section for a Thai multi-vendor marketplace called SKYMART. Visual world: ‘Market Hoarding’ — a screenprinted Bangkok street-fair flyer pinned over older layers, disciplined by one calm white shopping ticket. Marketplace abundance becomes a layered city of products while one finder panel keeps shopping clear.
Surface structure: a functional top navigation in bold white caps over the collage with SKYMART, categories, account and cart; one full-bleed cut-paper city-and-product collage carries several synthetic consumer products at different scales; a single clean white ticket panel floats above it and contains the Thai search field, two concise category/delivery selectors, one highlighted product with THB price and a clear add-to-cart action; a torn paper boundary reveals the next section as a calmer product strip and moving category marquee.
Mode: persuade. The visitor must instantly read marketplace, search, product facts, and primary shopping action.
Content: synthetic headphones, espresso maker, colorful carry-on luggage, sneakers, desk lamp, home accessories. Exact brand text: ‘SKYMART’. Exact primary CTA: ‘เพิ่มลงตะกร้า’. Exact search prompt: ‘วันนี้กำลังมองหาอะไร?’
Style/medium: production-grade ecommerce UI rendered as committed riso print and cut-paper material, semantic controls remain clean and readable; not a poster with decorative text and not a browser screenshot.
Color palette: cream #F3EDE0, ink #111111, orange #FF6A00, pink #EE1F8A, violet #7B57F0, lime #C9E250.
Materials/textures: gouache flats, riso grain, torn deckle edge, outlined cut-paper products, clean white ticket stock; no photography.
Composition/framing: 1440×1000 landscape desktop page, edge to edge with no browser chrome. One dominant collage gesture and one calm shopping ticket; realistic 16px body text scale.
Constraints: readable Thai labels; no invented commercial claims, discounts, awards, statistics or testimonials; no Apple or Shopee logos or trade dress; no generic split hero, no equal product-card row, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no watermark.
